description: Return the latest stored macroeconomic value for every available indicator in one currency, as a compact current macro snapshot. An unverified announcement_datetime has unproven origin; it is neither a verified scheduled time nor observed actual publication. Report absent schedule, publication and ingestion evidence as unknown, and latency as not measured. Access: USD needs no API key; other currencies return subscription_required with a subscribe link.

lang.description: Optional language for names and labels, for example `es` or `pt-BR`. A regional tag falls back to its base language and an unsupported language returns English. Slugs, codes, dates and values never change; the stored English name is kept in `name_original`.

since.description: changes only: previous next_cursor, ISO 8601 time or epoch seconds.

view.description: latest (default): newest value per indicator. changes: feed of newly ingested announcements; pass next_cursor back as `since`.

name: latest_announcements
title: Latest Macro Announcements
